svg.aria-label: One operator reads one FluxInstance: 1. Install: Flux installs the flux-operator chart, which runs one Deployment and its CRDs in flux-system. 2. Reconcile: The operator reads the FluxInstance named flux and installs or upgrades the controllers it declares. 3. Admit: A supplemental NetworkPolicy admits DNS replies, which the chart policy alone would drop. 4. Measure: A ServiceMonitor scrapes the operator. The flux-instance alerts read the series that Flux exports.
